import sys
import time

def bubble_sort(arr):
    n = len(arr)
    start_time = time.time()
    arr_copy = arr[:]
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(0, n - i - 1):
            if arr_copy[j] > arr_copy[j + 1]:
                arr_copy[j], arr_copy[j + 1] = arr_copy[j + 1], arr_copy[j]
    end_time = time.time()
    return arr_copy, (end_time - start_time) * 1000

def merge_sort(arr):
    start_time = time.time()
    result = _merge_sort_helper(arr)
    end_time = time.time()
    return result, (end_time - start_time) * 1000

def _merge_sort_helper(arr):
    if len(arr) <= 1:
        return arr
    mid = len(arr) // 2
    left = _merge_sort_helper(arr[:mid])
    right = _merge_sort_helper(arr[mid:])
    return merge(left, right)

def merge(left, right):
    result = []
    i = j = 0
    while i < len(left) and j < len(right):
        if left[i] <= right[j]:
            result.append(left[i])
            i += 1
        else:
            result.append(right[j])
            j += 1
    result.extend(left[i:])
    result.extend(right[j:])
    return result

def main():
    lines = sys.stdin.read().strip().split('\n')
    if not lines:
        return
    
    n = int(lines[0])
    
    if n == 0 or len(lines) < 2:
        print("Bubble Sort: []")
        print("Time taken by Bubble Sort: 0 ms")
        print("Merge Sort: []")
        print("Time taken by Merge Sort: 0 ms")
        return
    
    arr = list(map(int, lines[1].split()))
    arr = arr[:n]
    
    bubble_result, bubble_time = bubble_sort(arr)
    merge_result, merge_time = merge_sort(arr)
    
    print(f"Bubble Sort: {bubble_result}")
    print(f"Time taken by Bubble Sort: {int(bubble_time)} ms")
    print(f"Merge Sort: {merge_result}")
    print(f"Time taken by Merge Sort: {int(merge_time)} ms")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
